events.event: MSCI announced its November 2026 index review: Barito Pacific (BRPT) was removed from the MSCI Global Standard index and Bumi Resources Minerals (BRMS) moved down to Small Cap, while seven Indonesian stocks were deleted from Small Cap.
events.key_numbers: Standard: BRPT out, BRMS to Small Cap, no Indonesian additions · Small Cap deleted: AVIA, CTRA, MTEL, EMTK, JSMR, RAJA, WIFI · 8 stocks leave coverage entirely (BRPT + 7) · effective after close Mon 30 Nov (from 1 Dec) · 12 Nov moves: MTEL -6.75%, WIFI -5.13%, BRPT -1.96% to Rp750, RAJA +2.88%, BRMS +0.67% to Rp300 · outlets count 8 vs 9 removals depending on how BRMS is counted
events.why_it_matters: The feared worst case (a wider purge or reclassification) did not happen, but index funds still have to sell these stocks by 30 Nov.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA terpopuler (MSCI ubah komposisi indeks); detik front page items 4-5; CNBC Indonesia market lead

events.event: The IHSG jumped 2.66% on 12 November to close around 5,250, its biggest daily gain in weeks, as the MSCI result and Vice President Gibran's resignation eased market worries.
events.key_numbers: Close ~5,250 (CNBC 5,250.90; Suara +135.87 pts) · +2.66% · prior close 5,115.04 · session I +2.20% to 5,227.50 · turnover Rp11.55-11.9 trillion (sources differ) · BBRI +5.94% to Rp3,030, BMRI +3.18%, BBCA +2.82% to Rp5,475 · DEWA +10.26%, ADRO +6.06%, PTBA +6.00% · sectors: industrials +4.53%, transport +3.12%, energy +2.86% · analysts: gain not attributable to politics alone
events.why_it_matters: A 2.7% one-day jump after weeks of falls shows how much the market was pricing in political and MSCI fear.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #4 (Sandiaga on IHSG after Gibran exit); several detik front-page items

events.event: The rupiah weakened to about Rp18,216-18,239 per US dollar on 12 November, its weakest in months, while the stock index rallied; Bank Indonesia blamed Fed hike expectations, a strong dollar, MSCI worries and year-end dollar demand, and said it is intervening.
events.key_numbers: Close Rp18,216 (-0.26%, Suara) or Rp18,239 (-0.50%, Owrite) · intraday Rp18,221-18,241 · prior close ~Rp18,140-18,149 · DXY 102.96 = highest since Mar 2025 · BI: intervening via offshore NDF, DNDF, spot and secondary-market SBN purchases · BI FX reserves US$146.8 billion end-Oct · regional currencies -0.11% m/m · Suara cites a record low of Rp18,279 (unconfirmed; E0735 notes 2026 weakest close 8 Jun at Rp18,170-18,188)
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah raises prices of imported goods, fuel and anything priced in dollars.
events.spreading_evidence: detik front page #9 and #30; Suara headline 'titik terendah sepanjang masa'; many outlets ran BI explanation

events.event: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation letter to the MPR on 12 November, and markets treated it as easing political tension; the Presidential Communication Office said it would not disrupt the economy.
events.key_numbers: Letter handed to MPR ~11:00 WIB 12 Nov · IHSG session I +2.20% (+112.46 pts) after resignation news · 120 DPR members from 8 factions had filed an HMP over the diploma issue (HMP alone does not remove him) · State Secretary: Gibran raised resignation intent in 2-hour meeting 10 Nov · rupiah still weakened to ~Rp18,2xx same day
events.why_it_matters: Who becomes the next vice president now matters to investors and the rupiah.

events.event: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he backs a December rate hike and that a 50 bp hike should be considered if October core inflation is 0.3% or more, which Bank Indonesia cited as a key driver of dollar strength and rupiah weakness.
events.key_numbers: Waller remarks Tue 10 Nov (London) · 25 bp hike supported at 8-9 Dec FOMC; 50 bp if core CPI >=0.3% · futures ~85% odds of Dec hike (CME FedWatch cited 87-91% elsewhere) · US Oct CPI +0.4% m/m vs 0.3% forecast, core +0.3% (E0701) · Sept PCE 3.7% y/y per Kontan (E0413 says 3.6%; unreconciled) · DXY 102.96
events.why_it_matters: A US rate hike pulls money out of emerging markets and pushes the rupiah weaker, which could force BI to raise rates on 17-18 Nov.

events.event: President Prabowo said at the Nasdem 15th-anniversary event that the state budget loses about Rp480 trillion a year to inefficient goods-and-services procurement, and floated centralising purchasing.
events.key_numbers: Rp480 trillion/year lost · Katadata: goods-and-services spending ~Rp1,200 trillion, 40% wasted per LKPP head Sarah Sadiqa; Prabowo said one-third of APBN is goods and services · detik/Tirto headlines say '30% of APBN leaks' (conflicts with Katadata's one-third x 40%) · 38 provinces + ~500 regencies buy separately · centralising could save up to ~40% but 'not soon' · draft 2027 APBN spending Rp4,106.26 trillion, deficit Rp671.16 trillion (2.4% of GDP)
events.why_it_matters: Roughly Rp480 trillion is more than many ministries' yearly budgets, and the 30% vs 40% wording needs care before anyone repeats it.
events.spreading_evidence: detik front page #2; many regional outlets

events.event: Danantara launched PT Danareksa Investment Management Indonesia (Danareksa Investments), merging the asset managers of Mandiri, BRI, BNI and PNM, and said there will be no layoffs.
events.key_numbers: Merged: Mandiri Manajemen Investasi (surviving), BRI MI, BNI AM, PNM IM · AUM Rp172.5 trillion (~US$8.5 billion), second-largest manager in Indonesia · legal effect 1 Oct 2026, launch 11 Nov · ~280 staff, no layoffs (Rosan Roeslani) · AUM target Rp200 trillion in 2027 (ANTARA), Rp350 trillion later (ANTARA headline, unchecked)
events.why_it_matters: If you hold a mutual fund from one of these four state banks, its manager just changed hands.

events.event: Pertamina president director Simon Aloysius Mantiri apologised to DPR Commission VI for fuel (BBM) supply and distribution disruptions that caused long queues, and promised 24-hour terminals and SPBU, more tankers and modular SPBU.
events.key_numbers: Hearing Thu 12 Nov · Bali named as affected; Tribunnews headline says 'langka di 11 provinsi' (not confirmed in detik text) · cause given: Middle East conflict and Indonesia's geography, no specific incident · promises: 24-hour terminals/SPBU, extra tankers and crews, modular SPBU, higher year-end stock readiness · detik side items: Pertamina H1 2026 profit Rp34.58 trillion; planned +50,000 bpd production (unchecked)
events.why_it_matters: People queued for fuel and the year-end demand peak is coming.
